notes.title: Year One Update - patch notes! + TRAILER!
notes.notes:
We can't believe it's already been a year since we launched Overstep on Steam Early Access. It has been a year full of hard work, new experiences and it's been awesome to meet our players from all over the globe! 

Your feedback has been the secret weapon for traversing the land of iteration and dilemmas, from rail grind speeds to map sizes. It's like you're a part of the team - we couldn't be happier about it!

[previewyoutube=dtYz5xWfnSM;full][/previewyoutube]

FEATURES AND CONTENT:
 New in-game currency: Credits
 Earn credits by playing matches
 Skins can be purchased by Credits, except for Legendaries which remain OB-Only
 Adding a selection of Nationality based skins
 Customizable avatars and banners
 Skins now show on Trials and HUB
 Combat Tutorial Level
 Two new trial levels: Processing Plant and Launch Control
 Trial Times - Personal Records
 First version of the HUB
 Text Chat
 New competitive level: Atlas
 2 New weapons: Hailstorm, and Meltdown
 Special freerun practice area within the HUB
 Kill feed

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34976093/a550e88d4f2659dccd4cc0065af271fbe14cc433.jpg

IPROVEMENTS:
 Improved lobby lighting
 Music during lobby screen
 Fixed and brought back Gauss Gun
 Adjust the PLAY menu layout to welcome the HUB
 Tens of new and improved sound effects
 Online elements now working for offline levels (i.e. weapons on the HUB level)
 Option to configure the keys to use abilities

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34976093/c44f90ae77a4e202c79349efabbff847eb28ff58.jpg

BUG FIXES:
 Missing SFX on "continue" button at purchase screen
 Trial HUD is covering a part of the settings menu while in Trials
 Sound Effects volume slider not updating orb collection volume
 Volume sliders do not affect certain character SFX
 Camera shoulder setting doesn't work
 Windowed fullscreen doesn't work. Looks like normal fullscreen.
 Changing the quality settings and hitting apply sometimes doesn't save the settings
 Escape doesn't take you back a step in the in-match menu.
 In the settings menu. When Quality is not set to Custom, the individual Quality settings are greyed out. This is confusing some players who try to change the individual settings and not being able to do so.
 When using the lowest resolution value, texts on the loadout menu become off-centered and the matchmaking menu is almost unusable.
 Infinite running when pressing ESC during a match
 CTF mode; the Flag stays in water in Resort
 If you enter matchmaking and choose the Overstep Classic game mode. You sometimes get client-side flags that can't be interacted with.
 Weapons with splash damage do double damage
 Dead characters have no ragdoll behavior at all. The game still has the old dying animation.
 In the settings menu, using ‘reset to default’ reverts all settings to default, except for the resolution setting.
 Pressing F2 in Trials mode breaks it
 In the main menu, you can click on the friends and settings icons but only on the very top edge of their icons.
 Parties permanently block Trials mode, until restarting the game
 In the main menu, the platform meshes that the robots stand on have a gap between the top and the sides, allowing you to see a bit of the background through the platform.
 Heat mode doesn’t register kills/deaths count
 Blank widget avatar when not party host
 CTF flags are present in other game modes in the resort map
 Fixed inconsistency of skin rarity color between skins shop list and skin purchase popup
 Colored the skin labels by rarity on the store.
 Skin store sorts skins by rarity, corporation then, and finally name.
 Solved issue with the flag in robot's back not being replicated if players are too far from each other
 One of the party members doesn't travel to lobby upon successful match found


See you today at the HEAT-ed up Friday! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34976093/5c90ae31efba7b262b720649761a681372824f0e.png
Join our CEO Marten and CTO Flavio on the arenas and tune in for a chat! http://twitch.tv/overstepgame
6PM GMT!

Keep an eye on our Development Roadmap here: https://trello.com/b/pM6hdG56/overstep-development-roadmap

notes.title: Update no. 0.5526846 patch notes!
notes.notes:
FEATURES:
 Added the option to start MATCHMAKING DURING A TRIALS MATCH! 
(access in-match menu to trigger it!)
 Added rag-doll behaviour on death.
 Added hit vignettes and sounds to the abilities.

IMPROVEMENTS:
 Added Orion Bonds to the top menu bar.
 Decreased the volume of certain menu buttons.
 If an opponent dies via arena hazards or the Kill-Z within 3 seconds of you shooting them, you will now be awarded the kill.
 Improvements to drone VFX.
 Added support to the display settings screen, so attempting to change graphics quality will automatically switch the quality preset to Custom.
 Improved the matchmaking status widget and added marquee animation to 'searching'.
 Bound shortcut keys to in-match matchmaking widget.
 Added feedback to the main 'Play' button so it becomes clearer that it can be pressed while matchmaking.

BUG FIXES:
 Updated Blur and Ghost VFX, and fixed concurrency giving priority to the Ghost ability.
 Weapon VFX now works correctly with Blur and Ghost.
 Resolved miscellaneous code-based performance issues.
 Fixed player and party-member avatars displaying incorrectly in main menu.
 Fixed Friends icon number inconsistency.
 Fixed buttons not being clickable in some menus.
 Suiciding in Trials mode broke the game (administered anti-depressants to the code).
 Main menu avatar and invite fixes.
 Fixed size discrepancy with the flag in the Resort level (no more shrinking shark).
 Fixed minor issues with the matchmaking widget.
 

Keep an eye on our Development Roadmap here: https://trello.com/b/pM6hdG56/overstep-development-roadmap

notes.title: Update no. 5323789 patch notes!

 Visual settings not working fully


Keep an eye on our Development Roadmap here: https://trello.com/b/pM6hdG56/overstep-development-roadmap

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - Overstep 0.2!
notes.notes:
FEATURES:
 The ability system first pass!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34976093/15f3de60a8b101b2a6813961f54c6fad07888adc.gif

CONTENT:
 ARTED VERSION OF RESORT!
 Starport map blockout version!
 Temple of Boom map blockout version!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34976093/2f26cd68fc824ee3abf7dcdc8f29f81c67562013.jpg

IMPROVEMENTS/BALANCING:
 Respawn timer is increased from 3 to 5 seconds
 Visual feedback for player death on KillZ (void)
 ESC now closes settings, friends, and Orion Bond store screens.
 The Quick Game card got a simple re-design for better readability
 Width of keyboard bindings window was too small in some situations, it's wider now
 Added resolution settings
 Added windowed/full screen options
 New desktop icon
 Added Early Access text to loading screens
 A party widget so you can see who is in your party and their status (top right)
 Re-design for the Orion Bond Store purchase message
 Clicking the 'Purchase' now has a confirmation pop-up with the price. Before, it auto-purchased, players shouldn't be punished for a misclick.
 If a player clicks the empty space in the 'Redeem Code' area to select the input field, it does not work
 When finishing a run of Trials, the text should be tweaked from "You have found all the orbs!" to "You found all the orbs!


BUG / ISSUES FIXED:
 Half of the enemy weapons show no VFX to the player.
 Rockets always appear as red when being carried. When an enemy is carrying the player team's rocket it should be blue
 Player level on the scoreboard says CorpName
 Scrollbars should be outside the container for skin and weapon selection
 Devastator has an incorrect icon
 In the Skins sub-menu, selecting 'Get Skins Now!' takes you to the Store page, but does not update the heading tabs at the top - it remains on 'Loadout' instead of switching to 'Store'
 After you have invited someone, the free slot retains the '+' symbol. Should have an invitation cooldown.
 OB Store button - wrong highlight color
 Settings Button - default state is currently "hover". Friends Button - hover state is wrong. Both buttons are missing an Active state
 The 'Coming Soon' needs to be more prominent on the League and the Hub options
 Sub-Menu Active button gray background should be the same as default
 After you click 'Capture the Flag' to start matchmaking, it greys out and looks like you broke something
 Friends Button - Statically showing 5 friends online
 Sub-menu (everywhere) Sound Cue plays twice, On click and on release
 Slight errors in Quick Game CTF description: "opponents" should be "opponent's", and "return to your spawn point" should be "return to your flag zone".
 While looking for a game, if you click the 'x' to cancel, the timer briefly flashes "00:-1"
 Turntables shouldn't be visible without more players in your party
 Controller buttons shouldn't be visible without a controller
 Starting QP lacks feedback on the queue starting successfully.
 Players will get stuck without being able to move if they shift + tab in an ongoing match
 The back button has the incorrect design
 If both players send and accept an invite, it will bug out the party system
 All party members should receive a notification when a player has joined or left the party
 No indication as to whether they non-party-host has entered matchmaking or not. Non-Party Hosts don't see matchmaking status
 Invite Button - default, and hover state are wrong
 When a player closes the game, the party is not disbanded on either side
 Sometimes, not all players show in the lobby before map selection display
 Settings - Pressing 'Reset to Default' does not reset all to default, it only affects Resolution Scale
 OB Store - There is a horizontal scrollbar due to sizing of the package buttons
 OB Store - Spaces between cards can be smaller
 When finishing a run of Trials, the text should be tweaked from "You have found all the orbs!" to "You found all the orbs!
 After you have invited someone, the free slot retains the '+' symbol


Keep an eye on our Development Roadmap here: https://trello.com/b/pM6hdG56/overstep-development-roadmap


COMMUNITY CHALLENGE WITH AWESOME AWARDS!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34976093/8a4837fed2d75173524f9b3b10c6bd3653db4e8b.png

This community challenge contains two perk levels, one at 100 matches, and one at 200 matches. As it's a community challenge, ALL games matter, and everyone will earn the perk rewards. If the community reaches 100 matches, everyone will be rewarded with 200 Orion Bonds. And at 200 matches, all players will earn the exclusive Vector Pearlshift skin! (...may or may not contain real pearls...). You have 14 days, so get Overstepping!

AND WE'LL SEE YOU TODAY AT THE HEAT-ED UP FRIDAYS!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34976093/5c90ae31efba7b262b720649761a681372824f0e.png

Every week, every Friday, our community comes together to bring the HEAT to the Overstep arenas. This time our CEO Marten and CTO Flavio are taking over the event! 

Starting TODAY at 5 PM UTC!

Marten and Flavio will be streaming the game on Overstep Twitch channel and answering all of your questions.

The new menus will allow you to play 3 different orb runs and vote between 4 different maps for Capture the Flag.

NEW FEATURES AND CONTENT:
 Totally new and fresh main menu
 3 different speedrun challenges
 Map voting for Capture the Flag
 MISSIONS page with community challenges

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34976093/25d33905e4d61d9dcada4d75bb1b2e5399a5fa47.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34976093/29b678e2d48eed04429b697bae5098151a191d8d.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34976093/5b0befae6bf23d44ffbd042e583f1e4e09f24266.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34976093/ae8cbe19f02c05e11da709081d1efca6d79a3da9.gif

IMPROVEMENTS:
 Sound for Match Found
 Special Effect for stealing the flag


BUG FIXES:
 In lobby/menu cursor disappears and locks in place when I click on anything that isn't interactable
 Graphics are too bright if the settings are set to lower than Epic
 Sometimes a "Failed to connect" message will appear and the "Searching for game" window will appear and get stuck on the screen
 Log in rewards possibly resetting at random


COMMUNITY CHALLENGE WITH AWESOME REWARDS!

This community challenge contains two perk levels, one at 250 matches, and one at 500 matches. As it's a community challenge, ALL games matter, and everyone who contributes will earn the perk rewards. Once the community reaches 250 matches, everyone who took part will be rewarded with 500 Orion Bonds. And at 500 matches, all participants will earn the exclusive Vector Pearlshift skin! (...may or may not contain real pearls...). You have 10 days, so get Overstepping!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34976093/6d46f8af725321c23c76292dcdce6543632e198b.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34976093/e37514fa0c3b43b63ee827ac0ebfa79ce678cbab.png

What's next?

We'll bring back the party system and finish up the text chat. After that, we will take a few weeks for general bug fixes and polish. Once that is done, our focus is on combat. For that, we are already churning out special abilities, a vast number of weapons and working on a player loadout to accommodate all of that in the coolest way possible.

Keep an eye on our Development Roadmap here: https://trello.com/b/pM6hdG56/overstep-development-roadmap
